svg.title: MPSMA-DEIM detector architecture
svg.desc: The HGNetv2-B0 backbone passes the input through MPS and four gated stages. Tensors are labelled channels × height × width. Stage 3 feeds both Stage 4 and the hybrid encoder. The n model uses the stride-16 and stride-32 features at width 128. The s configuration also uses Stage 2 at stride 8, shown dashed, and has width 256. The hybrid encoder feeds the D-FINE decoder and then boxes and scores. The input thumbnail is an archived VisDrone example. The output symbol is schematic.
svg.metadata: Scientific sources: revision 44, Figure 1 labels, FULL_FRESH.yml and S1_模型配置摘录.json. Input thumbnail: source_snapshot/dataset_examples/0000280_02201_d_0000623.jpg. Layout reference: MambaVision, CVPR 2025, Figure 2 (horizontal backbone and aligned tensor labels). All module graphics, labels and connectors were redrawn for this detector.

g.inkscape:label: Input image
g.desc: VisDrone image 0000280_02201_d_0000623.jpg, from the paper workspace's source_snapshot/dataset_examples. Full frame resized to 640 × 640.

g.inkscape:label: Multi-branch Progressive Stem
g.desc: The simplified three-way fork and join denotes the MPS. The output is 16 × 160 × 160.

g.inkscape:label: Boxes and scores
g.desc: Two schematic outputs: bounding boxes and class scores. The glyphs do not present example detections or numerical scores.
